## 2. Technical Stack & Architecture Matrix

- **State & Data Fetching**: React Hooks, SWR, TanStack Query, Optimistic UI updates
- **Standards & Performance**: 100/100 Lighthouse performance, sub-second LCP, zero CLS layout shifts, WCAG AA/AAA color contrast

### Backend & Microservices Architecture
- **Runtimes & Frameworks**: Node.js 22, Express.js, TypeScript, RESTful API architecture, OpenAPI / Swagger 3.0
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL (Relational schema modeling, index optimization), MongoDB (Document storage, aggregation pipelines)
- **Caching & Message Queues**: Redis (In-memory caching, pub/sub, rate limiting, session storage), Kafka
- **Security & Auth**: JWT (JSON Web Tokens), OAuth2, Google SSO, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Helmet, rate-limiting, CORS, input sanitization

### AI / ML & Generative Engine Integration
- **LLM APIs**: Google Gemini API (Gemini 2.5 Flash / Pro), OpenAI API (GPT-4o), Anthropic Claude API
- **RAG Architecture**: PostgreSQL `pgvector` vector database extension, embedding generation, semantic similarity retrieval
- **Agentic Workflows**: LangChain, structured tool calling, prompt injection hardening, streaming response handlers

### Mobile App Development (Cross-Platform)
